title: The Final Chapter of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: In the reshaped rules of the Three Realms, Chen Ji accidentally glimpsed the death prophecy from Chapter 700 that once belonged to him—the ending that had kept him awake at night, now turned to nothingness.

text.content: At the moment the dimensional rift completely sealed, the core forbidden artifact in Chen Ji's palm, whose warmth had faded, suddenly burst forth with unprecedented light—this was not an ending, but the beginning of a complete rewriting of the Three Realms' landscape. He felt his consciousness stretching infinitely, like spider silk drawn into a thin thread, connecting every node in the shattered Void. His body burned, his Heavenly Fate Value drained at an unprecedented rate, yet that tearing agony carried an odd thrill, as if some long-sealed door was blasting open within him. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul quivered violently on the first page of the Tianji Record—that ancient voice carried a trembling fear for the first time—"Fifth dimension... walker... you actually did it..." Chen Ji did not answer, because the answer was unfolding before his eyes: the fate lines of the entire Three Realms, like an incomprehensibly vast and precise spider web, laid clearly before him.

The will of the Eye of Heavenly Mandate crashed down like bitter winter cold, that voice no longer the lofty indifference from before, but carrying an unprecedented panic: "A mere ant dares to lay hands on Heavenly Secrets!" Chen Ji felt that will like an invisible giant hand, trying to yank him down from the fifth dimension's perspective. But he did not resist—instead, he rushed against that force. "Senior," his voice terrifyingly calm, "you've plotted for ten thousand years, using generations of prophets as chess pieces, treating the Tianji Record as a tool. But you miscalculated one thing—" his consciousness tore through the dimensional gap, "I, Chen Ji, never liked being a chess piece." The Tianji Record burst open in his hands, each page erupting with blinding golden light, those fragmented characters auto-completing, as if responding to its true master's call.

dialogue.content: "You think mastering dimensional power allows you to gamble with Heaven? How laughable!" The Eye of Heavenly Mandate's will erupted with boundless fury, "Since the day this Seat existed, that has been the source of the Great Dao! Every Tianji Record holder through the ages—hasn't every one danced in the palm of this Seat? You are merely the seventeenth!"

text.content: The seventeenth. Chen Ji froze in the dimensional torrent. That number was like a basin of cold water, instantly cooling him. Sixteen... seniors... so what happened to those sixteen people? The moment that thought arose, the Tianji Record automatically provided the answer—those blurry images flashed through his consciousness: the first prophet died to heavenly tribulation, the second exhausted his Heavenly Fate Value and turned to ash, the third was directly erased by the Eye of Heavenly Mandate's will... all the way to the sixteenth, who almost succeeded, yet was blasted to pieces by lightning from the heavens at the final step. Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. But immediately, a cold smile curved his lips: "So you've been watching all along. Watching us struggle, watching us fail, watching us despair... then continuing to seek the next controllable chess piece?"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed from deep within the Tianji Record, ancient and weary: "Little junior brother... no, Sect Master... this old one harmed you. The Tianji Record was Senior Brother Chen Xuan's lifelong心血. He foresaw this tribulation, so he sealed this old one's remnant soul on the first page... this old one should have guided you at critical moments, but your schemes ran too deep, too deep for even this old one to see through." The remnant soul's voice carried sobs, "Senior Brother... he knew long ago you would walk this path, so he wagered everything on you."

text.content: Chen Xuan. That name exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder. His ancestor, the legendary figure who had schemed behind the scenes all along without ever meeting—had selected him from the very beginning? The Tianji Record flipped automatically again, countless images flickering past like a carousel—he saw Chen Xuan standing before the Hall of Heavenly Secrets, gazing at young Chen Ji, his eyes full of complex anticipation; saw Chen Xuan, on his deathbed, injecting his final wisp of divine sense into the Tianji Record, murmuring: "This child... is more suited than me... and carries deeper obsessions than me..." Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that laughter echoing through the dimensional gap, carrying a hint of bitterness and release. "So that's how it was. Ancestor, you truly were a bastard." He said quietly, "You knew the fates of those sixteen people ahead, yet you still pushed me onto this path?"

choice.prompt: Faced with the Eye of Heavenly Mandate's pressure and Chen Xuan's countless layered schemes, Chen Ji must make the final choice—toward what purpose will he use his fifth dimensional power?

choices.description: Using the power of the Fifth Dimension Walker to completely rewrite the Three Realms' Heavenly Dao rules, sealing the Eye of Heavenly Mandate, establishing new order—this means Chen Ji will forever bear Heavenly Mandate's backlash until the end of his life.
choices.visible_reward: Completely Rewrite Three Realms Rules, Establish New Order
choices.risk_hint: The price is a lifelong curse

text.content: Chen Ji's consciousness expanded rapidly in the fifth dimension, he felt himself becoming an endless web, shrouding the entire Three Realms. "Since Heaven's Dao can be manipulated," his voice rang like great bells, "then I shall create a Heaven's Dao that cannot be manipulated." He extended his hand—that hand, at the dimensional level, was no longer flesh and blood, but brilliant light woven from countless fate threads—and abruptly seized the great web representing the Eye of Heavenly Mandate's will.

choices.description: Share the responsibility of destiny writing with Su Qingyao, making her the new force balancing Heavenly Dao—this requires sharing the Tianji Record's core with her, meaning a bond of lifetime.
choices.visible_reward: Co-govern the Three Realms, accompany each other eternally

text.content: Chen Ji's consciousness pierced through dimensional barriers, precisely locating Su Qingyao anxiously waiting in the ruins of Tianqing Sect. He felt her heartbeat, the dried tear marks at her eyes, and the pure power within her that rightfully belonged to the Tianji Record. "Qingyao," his voice echoed directly in her soul, "are you willing? To write new Heavenly Mandate together with me."

choices.description: Using fifth dimensional power to completely sever the connection between the Tianji Record and the Eye of Heavenly Mandate, so the Three Realms will have no more prophets—this is the most resolute choice, but it will also cut off all future possibilities of breaking through using Heavenly Secrets power.
choices.visible_reward: Completely Liberate the Three Realms, Annihilate the Eye of Heavenly Mandate
choices.risk_hint: Will Lose All Heavenly Secrets Abilities

text.content: Chen Ji's palm abruptly clenched, the Tianji Record in his hand emitting a sharp wail. "Since these Heavenly Secrets have always been a curse," his voice cold as ice, "then let us—" He did not finish, because at this moment, a small figure suddenly appeared in his dimensional perception. It was Chen Nian, his missing sister, standing at the edge of the dimensional rift, being torn by that residual chaotic force, in danger of being swallowed at any moment. Chen Ji's hand froze mid-air.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's voice came from the edge of the dimensional rift, weak but firm: "Brother... don't give up your plan for me... I know you're someone destined for greatness..." Her figure flickered in the chaotic force like a specter, as if about to be torn apart at any moment, "Mother said before she died... Chen family children are born for this world... I don't blame you..."

text.content: Chen Ji's consciousness felt like struck by thunder. When had this little girl who always timidly followed behind him become so understanding? The Chen Nian in memory was still that girl who would cry loudly to grab the meat from his bowl, still that silly girl who would stand in front of him when he was bullied by fellow disciples. But now, she stood at the edge of chaos, threatening him with her life to abandon a plan he had laid for ten years. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented interweaving of anger and helplessness. He remembered the decision he made in Volume Seven—at that time, he could have chosen to abandon searching for Chen Nian and focus on dealing with the Eye of Heavenly Mandate, but he couldn't. Some things were more important than the Tianji Record, more important than the Three Realms' fate, more important than his own life. "Chen Nian," his voice echoed through the dimension, "Wait for me."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's voice suddenly penetrated the dimensional barrier, carrying a resolve: "Chen Ji, I heard you. Where are you? I sense you're doing something very dangerous—bring me." Her consciousness was like a drawn sword, piercing directly into the fifth dimensional gap, "You think I don't know? From the moment you saved me in the Hall of Heavenly Secrets, I knew you were no ordinary person. I chased you for eight full years—did you think it was just to stand by and watch at the final moment?"

text.content: Chen Ji was stunned. Su Qingyao's consciousness was so clear, so firmly standing alongside him in the dimensional gap. Her figure gradually materialized before his eyes—not flesh and blood, but a brilliant outline woven from countless laws of cause and effect, standing shoulder to shoulder with him, like two towering trees growing side by side. He suddenly realized, this was the best choice. Not bearing it alone, not destroying everything, but—"Sharing life." He said quietly, "Qingyao, are you certain? This means your fate will be forever bound with mine, until one of us dies." Su Qingyao did not answer, only extended her hand. Chen Ji smiled, reached out and grasped that palm also woven from fate threads. In an instant, the Tianji Record burst open, golden light flourishing, countless words cascading like a waterfall, leaving traces in every corner of the Three Realms—new rules, new order, new Heavenly Dao.

dialogue.content: The Eye of Heavenly Mandate's will emitted an earth-shaking roar in the golden light: "Impossible! How could you ants—" But its voice grew weaker, because the new Heavenly Dao web woven from countless fate threads was压制ing it bit by bit, sealing it, finally locking it completely in an unknown dimensional gap. "You forced this upon me!" The Eye of Heavenly Mandate let out its final roar, "Even if this Seat perishes, the dimensional invasion will not stop! Someday, something more terrifying will—" The voice cut off abruptly. Sealing complete.

choice.prompt: After the Eye of Heavenly Mandate was sealed, Chen Ji needed to handle the final threats—the residual forces of dimensional invasion and old grudges.

choices.description: As the previous generation's inheritance candidate, Ling Yuan's grudge toward Chen Xuan continues to this day. He appears to shelter but harbors malicious intent—this requires a final resolution—kill or release, both are difficult choices.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger turmoil within Tianqing Sect
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan Still Has Counterattack Strength

text.content: Ling Yuan's figure appeared above the ruins of Tianqing Sect—that once ambitious old Sect Master now disheveled, white hair flying wildly in the wind. But his gaze remained sharp, still carrying that bone-deep hatred of the betrayed. "Chen Ji..." his voice hoarse, "You think you've won? You're just another pitiful creature devoured by the Tianji Record."

choices.description: As Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, Han Lie possesses monstrous combat power but simple mind, repeatedly defeated by Chen Ji yet grows stronger with each defeat. Now he has let go of his obsession, needs someone to point him toward a new path.
choices.visible_reward: Turn enemy into friend, gain powerful ally
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's personality is extreme, may relapse

text.content: Han Lie stood alone atop Xuanwu Sect's peak, those once invincible eyes now full of confusion. The moment the Eye of Heavenly Mandate was sealed, he felt the source of the狂暴 force within him being severed—that "heaven-bestowed power" granted by the Eye of Heavenly Mandate was rapidly receding. "Chen Ji..." he murmured to himself, "Turns out I was never any genius, just someone else's chess piece..." He threw his head back laughing, that laughter bitter and desolate.

choices.description: Chen Nian is the Heavenly Mandate Key, her fate tightly connected to the Tianji Record. Right now she's trapped at the edge of the dimensional rift, must be rescued immediately—this is Chen Ji's responsibility as her brother.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes large amounts of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Brother and sister reunited, fulfill promise to mother
choices.risk_hint: May affect the stability of the new order

text.content: Chen Ji's consciousness instantly crossed dimensional barriers, arriving beside Chen Nian. The little girl's figure grew fainter in the chaotic force, as if about to dissipate at any moment. Chen Ji reached out, pulling her into his embrace. Chen Nian froze, then burst into tears: "Brother... I thought I'd never see you again..." Her small hands clutched Chen Ji's robe like grasping the entire world.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's figure came through the air from the direction of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, demonic mists churning around her, yet no longer carrying that sinister aura from before. She stopped before Chen Ji, revealing a genuine smile for the first time: "Chen Ji, you truly didn't disappoint me. The dimensional invasion is temporarily suppressed, but that rift... hasn't completely disappeared." Her gaze was profound, "I will continue guarding there after the Demonic Path Holy Sect is rebuilt. Mist can conceal Heavenly Secrets' aura—this is the pact between us."

text.content: Chen Ji nodded. He looked at these people before him—Su Qingyao standing at his side, no longer needing words to communicate their hearts; Chen Nian hiding behind him, curiously yet reverently surveying this entirely new world; Ye Qing standing with hands behind her back, the Demonic Path Holy Maiden's pressure now carrying more composure; in the distance, Han Lie's figure was departing, his silhouette desolate yet no longer戾气; and Ling Yuan... that old man ultimately chose seclusion, no longer concerning himself with sect affairs, an implicit acknowledgment of past grudges. "Mo Xiansheng," Chen Ji suddenly spoke, "Shouldn't you come out and say something?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted from the first page, the old face full of relief: "Sect Master... no, little junior brother, this old one only has one thing to say—if Senior Brother has any awareness in the underworld, he will surely smile contentedly."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao said softly: "Chen Ji, the new Heavenly Dao's rules... we need to perfect them quickly. There are still many details to finalize, like the distribution of Heavenly Fate Value, the spiritual energy circulation of the Three Realms, and..." She paused, cheeks slightly flushed, "And the specifics of the life-sharing contract between us." Chen Ji couldn't help smiling, reaching out to rub her hair: "What's the rush? We have all the time in the world." He raised his head, gazing at that sky finally restored to peace. The dimensional rift had completely sealed, but the Tianji Record's perception told him that in the far distant Void, that scar still existed, merely temporarily suppressed. Threats will never truly vanish, but at least—for now, the Three Realms were at peace.

text.content: The Tianji Record slowly closed in Chen Ji's palm, that once scalding light finally returning to calm. He lowered his head, gazing at this book that had accompanied him through his entire cultivation journey, suddenly remembering his feelings over a thousand chapters ago when he first opened it as a Menial Servant. Back then, he thought he had obtained a tool to defy fate and change destiny, not knowing that fate had long marked its price in the shadows. Along the way, he lost too much, yet gained too much as well. Nearly half his Heavenly Fate Value consumed, countless years shaved from his lifespan, and debts of gratitude beyond counting. But now, looking at these people beside him—his sister, his beloved, his allies, his opponents—he suddenly felt it was all worth it. "Let's go," he said quietly, "There are still many matters to attend to in the new order." Su Qingyao nodded, flying shoulder to shoulder with him toward Tianqing Sect. And Chen Nian rode atop a little phoenix that had somehow appeared, giggling along behind them.

Just as the three figures were about to vanish into the clouds, Chen Ji's gaze suddenly sharpened. He saw—in the reshaped rules of the Three Realms, in that gap of Heavenly Dao's operation, a blurry image was flickering into view. It was the prophecy from Chapter 700, the death ending he had glimpsed countless times yet never managed to change. Now, that image had completely vanished, replaced by a hazy light pointing toward a future he had never seen. A smile curved Chen Ji's lips as he murmured something. Su Qingyao tilted her head to listen but couldn't catch it. "What did you say?" she asked. Chen Ji shook his head, his gaze profound: "Nothing. Just suddenly feeling that this 'useless character' persona... I probably can no longer maintain." Clouds surged, the morning sun rose. The new Three Realms, at this moment, officially began.
